data.name: NavRecord
data.comment: Top navigation. The predecessor called this tab "Spy"; plan §0 renames it.

data.name: NavSettings
data.comment: Top navigation.

data.name: NavAdvanced
data.comment: Top navigation.

data.name: RecordStatusIdle
data.comment: Shown above the activity log before a session starts.

data.name: RecordStatusWaiting
data.value: Waiting for Spotify to play something.
data.comment: Status line while a session is running but no track has started.

data.name: RecordStatusRecording
data.comment: Status line while audio is being captured.

data.name: RecordStatusStopping
data.comment: Status line while the encode queue drains after Stop. Stopping is not instant.

data.name: RecordStart
data.comment: The transport button when idle. Same verb as the status it produces.

data.name: RecordStop
data.comment: The transport button while a session runs.

data.name: RecordNothingPlaying
data.comment: Stands in for the track name when Spotify has no track on screen.

data.name: RecordLevelLabel
data.comment: Accessible name for the level meter. Screen readers get this; sighted users get the bars.

data.name: RecordCannotStartSettings
data.value: Settings could not be read, so recording did not start. Fix or delete the settings file and try again.
data.comment: Start failed. Recording on defaults would write to a folder the user never chose.

data.name: RecordCannotStartFfmpeg
data.value: ffmpeg was not found. Set its location on the Settings page, then start again.
data.comment: Start failed. Every conversion goes through ffmpeg, so there is no degraded mode.

data.name: RecordCannotStartAudioDevice
data.value: The audio device could not be opened. Check it is still connected, then start again.
data.comment: Start failed, usually a device unplugged since it was chosen in settings.

data.name: RecordFilterLabel
data.comment: Label for the activity log's level filter.

data.name: RecordFilterAll
data.comment: Log filter: no filtering, including debug detail.

data.name: RecordFilterActivity
data.comment: Log filter: information and above. The default — what the app is doing, without the detail.

data.name: RecordFilterProblems
data.comment: Log filter: warnings and errors.

data.name: RecordCopyLog
data.comment: Button that copies the visible log lines to the clipboard.

data.name: RecordLogCopied
data.comment: Logged after Copy log. {0} is the number of lines copied.

data.name: RecordClearLog
data.comment: Button that empties the activity log.

data.name: PageEmpty
data.comment: Placeholder for a page whose controls have not been built.

data.name: SettingsOutputSection
data.comment: Settings page: heading over the destination and format controls.

data.name: SettingsOutputPathLabel
data.comment: Settings page: label for the output folder box.

data.name: SettingsBrowse
data.comment: Opens a folder picker beside a path box.

data.name: SettingsStoredAt
data.comment: Footer on the Settings page. {0} is the full path to settings.json.

data.name: SettingsOutputPathRequired
data.comment: Inline validation: the output folder is empty.

data.name: SettingsOutputPathInvalid
data.value: This folder name contains characters Windows does not allow.
data.comment: Inline validation: the output folder holds invalid path characters.

data.name: SettingsOutputPathNotAbsolute
data.value: Enter a full path, starting with a drive letter or \\server\share.
data.comment: Inline validation: the output folder is relative, which would depend on how Offstream was launched.

data.name: SettingsDeviceLabel
data.comment: Settings page: label for the audio endpoint dropdown.

data.name: SettingsDeviceDefault
data.comment: First entry in the device dropdown: follow the default render endpoint.

data.name: SettingsDeviceUnavailable
data.comment: Device dropdown entry for a saved device that is not present right now. {0} is its id.

data.name: SettingsDeviceRefresh
data.comment: Re-enumerates audio devices, for one plugged in after Offstream started.

data.name: SettingsFormatLabel
data.comment: Settings page: label for the output format dropdown.

data.name: SettingsBitrateLabel
data.comment: Settings page: label for the bitrate dropdown.

data.name: SettingsBitrateItem
data.comment: One entry in the bitrate dropdown. {0} is the rate in kilobits per second.

data.name: SettingsBitrateNotApplicable
data.value: This format sets its own rate.
data.comment: Shown next to the disabled bitrate control for FLAC and WAV.

data.name: SettingsRecordingSection
data.comment: Settings page: heading over what gets kept.

data.name: SettingsMinimumLengthLabel
data.comment: Settings page: label for the minimum length box, which is followed by a seconds unit.

data.name: SettingsSecondsUnit
data.comment: Unit shown after the minimum length box.

data.name: SettingsMinimumLengthInvalid
data.value: Enter a whole number of seconds, from 0 to {0}.
data.comment: Inline validation for the minimum length box. {0} is the maximum accepted.

data.name: SettingsMetadataSection
data.comment: Settings page: heading over the metadata provider controls.

data.name: SettingsProviderLabel
data.value: Look up album and artwork with
data.comment: Settings page: label for the metadata provider dropdown.

data.name: SettingsProviderNone
data.value: Nothing — use the window title only
data.comment: Metadata provider option: no lookup at all.

data.name: SettingsProviderLastFm
data.comment: Metadata provider option. A product name; not translated.

data.name: SettingsProviderSpotify
data.comment: Metadata provider option. A product name; not translated.

data.name: SettingsClientIdLabel
data.comment: Settings page: label for the Spotify application id.

data.name: SettingsClientIdHint
data.value: From your own app on the Spotify Developer Dashboard. Register http://127.0.0.1:4002/callback as its redirect URI, then sign in below.
data.comment: Explains where the Client ID comes from and what has to be registered alongside it.

data.name: SettingsClientIdRequired
data.value: Enter a Client ID, or choose another source above.
data.comment: Inline validation: Spotify is the chosen provider but no Client ID is set.

data.name: SettingsLastFmApiKeyLabel
data.comment: Settings page: label for the user's own Last.fm API key.

data.name: SettingsLastFmApiKeyHint
data.value: Create one at last.fm/api/account/create. It takes a minute and is free.
data.comment: Explains where the Last.fm API key comes from.

data.name: SettingsLastFmApiKeyRequired
data.value: Without a key, nothing will be tagged. Enter one, or choose another source above.
data.comment: Inline warning: Last.fm is the chosen provider but no API key is set.

data.name: SettingsSpotifySignIn
data.comment: Settings page: button that starts the browser sign-in.

data.name: SettingsSpotifySigningIn
data.comment: Settings page: shown while the browser sign-in is open.

data.name: SettingsSpotifySignedIn
data.value: Signed in. Recordings will be tagged from Spotify.
data.comment: Settings page: a Spotify refresh token is stored.

data.name: SettingsSpotifyNotSignedIn
data.value: Not signed in. Nothing will be tagged until you are.
data.comment: Settings page: no Spotify refresh token is stored.

data.name: SettingsSpotifyAttribution
data.value: Track details and cover art are provided by Spotify.
data.comment: Settings page: Spotify Developer Terms require content from the API to be attributed to Spotify.

data.name: AdvancedNamingSection
data.comment: Advanced page: heading over the filename template controls.

data.name: AdvancedTemplateLabel
data.comment: Advanced page: label for the filename template box.

data.name: AdvancedTemplateTokens
data.comment: Button that shows the list of tokens a template may use.

data.name: AdvancedTemplateDefault
data.comment: Button that sets the template Offstream ships with.

data.name: AdvancedTemplateGrouped
data.comment: Button that sets the grouped template.

data.name: AdvancedPreviewLabel
data.comment: Prefix inside the live preview of the rendered file name.

data.name: AdvancedPreviewUnavailable
data.value: This template does not produce a file name.
data.comment: Shown instead of the preview when the template renders to nothing usable.

data.name: AdvancedTokenArtist
data.value: The artist, or all of them for a collaboration
data.comment: Token reference row.

data.name: AdvancedTokenTitle
data.comment: Token reference row.

data.name: AdvancedTokenAlbum
data.comment: Token reference row.

data.name: AdvancedTokenAlbumArtist
data.value: The album's artist, which differs from the track's on compilations
data.comment: Token reference row.

data.name: AdvancedTokenYear
data.comment: Token reference row.

data.name: AdvancedTokenTrack
data.value: Track number on the album; write {track:00} to pad it
data.comment: Token reference row. The braces are literal syntax and must not be translated.

data.name: AdvancedTokenDisc
data.comment: Token reference row.

data.name: AdvancedTokenCount
data.value: A number that grows with each recording; write {count:000} to pad it
data.comment: Token reference row. The braces are literal syntax and must not be translated.

data.name: AdvancedTokenDate
data.value: Today's date, as yyyy-MM-dd unless you give a format
data.comment: Token reference row. The date pattern is .NET syntax and must not be translated.

data.name: AdvancedTokenTime
data.value: The time the recording started, as HHmmss unless you give a format
data.comment: Token reference row. The time pattern is .NET syntax and must not be translated.

data.name: AdvancedSampleArtist
data.comment: Stand-in artist used to render the filename preview.

data.name: AdvancedSampleTitle
data.comment: Stand-in title used to render the filename preview.

data.name: AdvancedSampleAlbum
data.comment: Stand-in album used to render the filename preview.

data.name: AdvancedCounterLabel
data.comment: Advanced page: label for the running file counter.

data.name: AdvancedCounterHint
data.value: Used by the {count} token, and kept across restarts.
data.comment: Explains the counter box. The braces are literal template syntax.

data.name: AdvancedCounterInvalid
data.comment: Inline validation for the counter. {0} is the ceiling the template's padding allows.

data.name: AdvancedExistingLabel
data.comment: Advanced page: label for the existing-file policy dropdown.

data.name: AdvancedExistingSkip
data.comment: Existing-file policy: do not record over it.

data.name: AdvancedExistingOverwrite
data.comment: Existing-file policy: overwrite.

data.name: AdvancedExistingDuplicate
data.value: Save the new one alongside it
data.comment: Existing-file policy: keep both, numbering the newcomer.

data.name: AdvancedDetectionSection
data.comment: Advanced page: heading over what counts as a track worth recording. The predecessor called these "spy options"; plan §0 renames them.

data.name: AdvancedMuteAds
data.comment: Detection option: silence Spotify's adverts instead of hearing them.

data.name: AdvancedRecordEverything
data.comment: Detection option: do not require an artist - title window title.

data.name: AdvancedRecordEverythingHint
data.value: Includes podcasts and anything else without an artist.
data.comment: Explains the record-everything option.

data.name: AdvancedRecordAds
data.comment: Detection option, only meaningful while everything is being recorded.

data.name: AdvancedTimerEnabled
data.comment: Advanced page: turns the recording timer on, followed by a duration box.

data.name: AdvancedTimerInvalid
data.value: Enter a duration as hh:mm:ss, up to 99:59:59.
data.comment: Inline validation for the recording timer.

data.name: AdvancedTagsSection
data.comment: Advanced page: heading over what is written into the file's metadata.

data.name: AdvancedWriteCounter
data.value: Write the number into the track-number tag
data.comment: Tag option: put the running counter in the track number field.

data.name: AdvancedWriteCounterHint
data.value: Players then sort recordings in the order they were made.
data.comment: Explains the track-number tag option.

data.name: AdvancedAppSection
data.comment: Advanced page: heading over settings that are not about recording.

data.name: AdvancedMinimizeToTray
data.comment: Application option: keep running in the tray rather than on the taskbar.

data.name: AdvancedLanguageLabel
data.comment: Advanced page: label for the UI language dropdown.

data.name: AdvancedLanguageSystem
data.comment: Language option: follow the system UI language.

data.name: AdvancedLanguageRestart
data.value: Takes effect the next time Offstream starts.
data.comment: Explains that a language change is not applied live.

data.name: AdvancedFfmpegLabel
data.comment: Advanced page: label for the ffmpeg path box. A program name; not translated.

data.name: AdvancedFfmpegHint
data.value: Leave empty to use the copy shipped with Offstream, or ffmpeg on PATH.
data.comment: Explains the ffmpeg path box. PATH is the environment variable; not translated.

data.name: AdvancedFfmpegFound
data.comment: Shown under the ffmpeg box once a build is resolved. {0} is the full path.

data.name: AdvancedFfmpegMissing
data.value: No ffmpeg found. Recording cannot start until there is one.
data.comment: Shown under the ffmpeg box when nothing resolves, including the bundled copy and PATH.

data.name: AdvancedFfmpegNotFound
data.value: There is no ffmpeg.exe at that path.
data.comment: Inline validation: an explicit ffmpeg path that does not exist.

data.name: TrayShow
data.comment: Tray menu item that restores the window.

data.name: TrayExit
data.comment: Tray menu item that quits the app.

data.name: TrayIdle
data.comment: Tray tooltip while idle.

data.name: TrayRecording
data.comment: Tray tooltip while recording. {0} is the current track.

data.name: TrayWaiting
data.comment: Tray tooltip while a session is running but nothing is playing yet.

data.name: RecordTransportRecording
data.comment: Transport indicator on the display while audio is being written. A recorder marking; kept short and untranslated where that is the convention.

data.name: RecordTransportWaiting
data.comment: Transport indicator while the session is armed but between tracks.

data.name: RecordTransportStopped
data.comment: Transport indicator while nothing is running.

data.name: SettingsVirtualCableFound
data.value: VB-CABLE is installed. Route Spotify to it in Windows, then record it here.
data.comment: Shown under the device picker when a VB-Audio virtual cable endpoint exists.

data.name: SettingsVirtualCableMissing
data.value: VB-CABLE is not installed. Recording a normal output device captures every sound the machine makes, not only Spotify.
data.comment: Shown under the device picker when no VB-Audio virtual cable endpoint exists. Offstream ships no installer for it.

data.name: SettingsVirtualCableGet
data.comment: Link beside the missing-cable notice. Offstream never bundles the vendor's installer.

data.name: RecordSavedSection
data.comment: Heading over the list of files written since Start. The totals sit on this same line, right-aligned.

data.name: RecordSavedEmpty
data.comment: Placeholder shown while the saved list is empty.

data.name: RecordSavedOpen
data.comment: Context action on a saved recording.

data.name: RecordSessionTracks
data.comment: Session total, on the section heading. {0} is the number of files written this session.

data.name: RecordSessionDuration
data.comment: Session total, on the section heading. {0} is the combined duration as a clock, already formatted.

data.name: RecordDestinationLabel
data.comment: Row label on the live destination of the track being recorded.

data.name: RecordActivitySection
data.comment: Heading on the collapsible log panel.

data.name: RecordNoArt
data.comment: Accessible name for the album art placeholder.

data.name: RecordNowSection
data.comment: Heading over the cover art and details of the track being written right now.

data.name: RecordArtistLabel
data.comment: Row label on the artist and title of the track being recorded.

data.name: RecordAlbumLabel
data.comment: Row label on the album and release year of the track being recorded.

data.name: RecordElapsedLabel
data.comment: Caption over the counter on the display. Upper case because it is a legend printed on an instrument face, not a sentence.

data.name: NavLogs
data.comment: Fourth tab in the shell, after Advanced.
